needs_human.note: When the destination already holds a same-named subtitle, the request returns 200 with no user-visible message, the video's own sidecar stays behind under the old name, and the video now shows the other file's captions. The R-5 walk in decisions.md step 6 observed this and only a backend WARNING records it. The behavior is deliberate and tested for not overwriting, but no document states that the user sees another video's captions and is not told.; A sidecar move failure after the commit is logged only, so the API response reports full success while some tracks are detached. This is deliberate best effort, but the user cannot see it.; A video moved to another drive takes its subtitles along, including from a locked drive to an open one. The video itself moves the same way, so this looks consistent, but it is not stated.

On a destination collision, the operation returns success, the sidecar stays behind and the video plays the file already at the destination (subtitle.py:132-136).; Moved sidecars attach to whichever video holds the target stem: renaming movie.mp4 to film.mp4 when film.webm exists gives film.webm the moved tracks, because detection is stem-based (subtitle.py:83-88).; A sidecar is moved even when a trashed or other same-stem video also relies on it (subtitle.py:119-123).

Same-stem siblings: which file owns a shared sidecar is undefined, and the code gives it to whichever file is renamed or moved first.; A sidecar arriving beside an existing same-stem video becomes that video's track as well.; A collision at the destination yields a partial move reported as plain success.; A cross-drive sidecar move goes through shutil.move's copy and unlink, so a failure mid-copy can leave a partial target that detect_subtitles offers as a track, and a retry would then skip it because the target exists.; Intelligence's loft lookup uses the broader pattern `stem*.vtt` (addons/intelligence/app/workers/whisper.py:1745), while core moves only names matching the two-or-three-letter language rule. A `clip.notes.vtt` beside a loft stays behind on rename; before this commit it also stayed, so this is unchanged but now differs from the moved set.
